cards.title: Letter Y
sections: yogurt /ˈjoʊɡɚt/ · a food made from milk
In yogurt, y represents /j/. This is a word sound, not the letter name.
Write Y and y three times. Cover the model and write the pair again.

articulation.label: Letter Y
articulation.alt: Letter Y: /w/ → /aɪ/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /w/: Round the lips; raise the back of the tongue.
/a/: Start with the tongue low and jaw open.
/ɪ/: Glide up and forward; narrow the jaw gap.
articulation.note: Keep each vowel glide inside one syllable.

cards.title: Letter Z
sections: zebra /ˈzibrə/ · an animal with black and white stripes

Write Z and z three times. Cover the model and write the pair again.

articulation.label: Letter Z
articulation.alt: Letter Z: /z/ → /i/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /z/: A narrow gap near the ridge; add voice.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: Letter X
articulation.alt: Letter X: /ɛ/ → /k/ → /s/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /ɛ/: Front tongue; open the jaw a little more.
/k/: Back of tongue meets the soft palate; release.
/s/: Make a narrow gap near the ridge; let air flow.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

cards.title: Five words to hear and use
sections: A large animal with long hair that lives in cold mountain areas. The yak has long hair.
an animal with black and white stripes. The zebra has black and white stripes.
A place where people can see many kinds of animals. We see a zebra at the zoo.
the colour of a lemon. The banana is yellow.
